title: Panel references an entity/concept that isn't declared
body: A panel's data source points at an entity that the model doesn't declare. Either the entity name is misspelled, or the entity was never added. Fix: add the missing entity/concept to `entities`/`concepts`, or correct the panel's entity reference to an existing concept name (names are case-sensitive and must match exactly). Use `npdev_inspect_app` to list the concepts that already exist before referencing one.
fix: Add the entity to entities/concepts, or fix the panel's entity reference to an existing concept name (exact, case-sensitive). List existing concepts with npdev_inspect_app first.
